entry.title: I teach doctors how to interpret test results – and the labels ‘normal’ and ‘abnormal’ often hide what matters most
entry.summary: Labeling medical test results as ‘normal’ or ‘abnormal’ helps clinicians make quick judgments when diagnosing patients. But this binary approach to interpreting tests can lead to fatal errors.

author.name: Amiran Baduashvili, Associate Professor of Medicine, University of Colorado Anschutz
